owner: tools/migrations/roster_state_assignment.mjs; regenerate with node tools/migrations/roster_state_assignment.mjs --apply, never by hand
note: The old generated map's 1,332 states given to the 156 realms of roster.json until the new map from the owner's drawing replaces it. Every state carries its rule and reason so that the politics step can redo the assignment on the new map: kept and renamed rows keep their states, merged rows give them to the target, split rows divide them by nearest seat, removed rows give them to the realm or the wild-land holder named in `rules`, and realms with no old row take the states their dossier describes (`rules.carve`). The extent of most realms on this map differs from their roster `extent`; `realms` lists both counts. Owner decisions K35 (Tirlan) and K36 (the Concord) are followed.

carve.reason: The Cursed Mountains and the south of the Giant Mountains above the Forests of Darkhere, 2 states (middle_lands.md 3.7 and 11): 1288 at the south end of the Cursed Mountains ridge, where the throne-cave Glimzig lies, and 1286 under the Giant Mountains on the south-east edge of the Darkhere wood; the two border each other.

The gnome holts of the Deodolor Hills north of the Stone Forest, within a day's walk of Parim, 1 state (middle_lands.md 3.7): 240 (Stone Forest) is the state between the Deodolor ridge and the petrified wood.

The north-coast forest between Selen, Konori and the Bloody Forest, 3 states (middle_lands.md 2.5a): 133 (Aenor Forest) and 131 lie inside the coast forest and 879 carries it east under the Crown Mountains. Selen falls to the roster's about 9 states; its two eastern states (876 Kolula, 878) are cut off from its west on the old map.
The three Hilorn valleys inside Hirolon's ring, 1 state (hirolon.md 11, decision K35): 749 lies on the River Hilorn inside the ring; Hirolon keeps Bedogus (241) and Hunfeler (966).
The High Mountains at the centre of the island, joined to the Loso heights (north_lands.md 2 and 11): 1130 on the Loso line inside the Dwarc and Swy Forests, and 1140, which borders it.

The Herlitz and Dusty Mountains on the west spine of the Kradlon Peninsula; the Kradlon row gives the Herlitz range to the dwarves (west_lands.md 2 and 11): 263 and 264 are the peninsula's tail, Kradlon's only hill states; Kradlon keeps the rest in one piece.

The Bolpor and Boldor Mountains on the east flank of the Kulolo valley, with the Outer Gate above the Kulolo (west_lands.md 2 and 11): 116 lies on that line just east of the river; Lambin keeps 9 states.

The warm deep caves under the Goldoroth Mountains, heated by the volcano (dark_lands.md 2 and 11): 1151 (South Goldor) lies at the Goldoroth Volcano under the west end of the range, and taking it keeps Goldoroth in one piece. It is carved before the Goldoroth split.

The Giant Forest by the Giant River behind the Borderline of Giants (dark_lands.md 11): 440 and 1078 are both named The Borderline of Giants and border each other; one state each comes from The Darks and Blackton.

The oases of the dune sea in the south-west of the Sun Desert, about 4 states (south_lands.md 11), while Miaed keeps the Hardtmuth passes and the south coast: four contiguous desert states of Miaed around the centre of the Sun Desert.
The Keepers' God Forest south of Sun Lake, 1 state (lands_of_the_sun.md 11): 72 lies at the centre of the God Forest; Tor Luni keeps its capital and the other Godland states.

The fungal belt along the rift shore east of the Elwen, 3 states (magical_lands.md 2 and 11): three bordering states inside the fungal belt, 1236 nearest the Mushroom Forest. The old state 146 named Mushroom Forest lies far south-west of the belt and stays where it is.

veshazel.reason: The Goldoroth Ash Fields face the Sea of Dolon on the south of the Goldoroth arm (dark_lands.md 2 and 11): 313 (Goldoroth Islands) is the old Goldoroth state nearest that coast.

nether.reason: The Nether is the volcanic island south of the Ember Lands (nether.md): 143 (Death Islands) is the old Volgan state nearest the Nether.

ghaahu.reason: Ghaahu is the north-east snow plain among the Cold Mountains (cold_lands.md 11): the old Yeti Lands row lies in two clusters, and 374 anchors the north-east one.

Y7V.reason: The Lustras Hills of the krors lie south of the Herrodon Mountains (magical_lands.md 2); Herrodon borders both of the old Sacomananos states and holds the wild hills on the map.

Y7Y.reason: The Lost Lands are the empty shore under the Herrodon rim (magical_lands.md 7 and 11); Eldafaen borders five of the old Filion states, through its capital, and holds the empty coast on the map.
